## Downloads and limitations

- **Windows x64:** choose the setup EXE for a per-user installation with an uninstaller, or extract the portable ZIP and run `portspecter.exe`. The installer and executable are unsigned. Npcap is installed separately and is needed only for experimental SYN scans.

SYN is experimental and IPv4-only. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/Gorke07/PortSpecter/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md) for dependencies and optional permissions. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
